trigger: Predefined acceptance tests reproduce an intentionally seeded defect
problem: The duration parser returns only the last token's minutes

evidence.observation: 1h 30m reports 30 minutes; the specified total is 90

user_impact: Multi-token durations produce incorrect totals in this test application
proposed_change: Accumulate every valid duration token while preserving input validation
alternatives: Restrict input to one token, which would not satisfy the specified behavior
acceptance_criteria: Repeated units accumulate and whitespace does not change the total
Single-unit and zero values keep their existing behavior
Empty, negative, fractional, unsupported and malformed inputs remain rejected
The CLI reports the same total as the Python function
Only src/duration.py changes; the predefined tests remain unchanged
risks_non_goals: No dependency, test, workflow, agent-policy or configuration changes
No publication, merge or deployment by the worker
This seeded defect is a pilot target, not a genuine Scout finding
dependencies: Python 3.11 or later; standard library only
